note: Four agent-to-agent Resolve cases: a Meta Muse complaint arrives over the protocol adapter, Umpyr's agent (acting for BJ's under pack 2026-11-01.1) pulls the Check record and mandate, and the two agents negotiate turn by turn. Muse's moves are scripted here; Umpyr's are computed from the rule pack at run time. All synthetic; BJ's is not live on Muse.

cases.title: Substituted eggs, missing detergent, warm chicken: two agents converge
cases.tagline: Muse opens with four asks. Umpyr's agent refunds two lines at once, asks for evidence on the third, holds the fee, then concedes it when Muse shows the delivery was materially incomplete. Eleven turns, no person.

claims.detail: Wellsley Farms eggs replaced with Eggland's Best 18 ct; mandate m_e8bc163c had substitutions off
Tide PODS 112 ct not in the delivery
Chicken arrived warm to the touch; member discarded it
Delivery fee $9.99 for an incomplete delivery

muse.opening: Claim on BJ-7011 for member mem_ca0df2c95a. Mandate m_{mandate} (signed, substitutions off) was approved by Umpyr Check at 14:02 UTC. The delivery at 17:20 had three problems: the Wellsley Farms eggs (L4) were replaced with Eggland's Best 18 ct, the Tide PODS (L5) were not delivered, and the chicken (L1) was warm to the touch and has been discarded. The member asks for a refund of all three lines and of the $9.99 delivery fee, since the delivery was incomplete.

chicken._text: Evidence for L1 attached: two photos of the chicken and its thermometer reading (sha256 {photo_hash}), taken at 17:26 UTC, six minutes after delivery.

fee._text: On the fee: two of the five lines were wrong at the door (one substituted against the mandate, one missing). That is not a complete delivery, and the member paid $9.99 for a complete one. I am asking you to look at the fee again on that basis.

texts.accept: Accepted on behalf of the member: ${offer} across L1, L4, L5 and the delivery fee, with fault on the fulfilment partner. Please issue the terms.
texts.accept_terms: terms_accepted. Terms hash {terms_hash} verified against the terms you sent; signed with the member's delegation key. Proceed.
texts.acknowledge: Understood. I will record the outcome against the member's order and inform them.

cases.title: Ten cases, not ten packs: Umpyr holds firm on the Check evidence
cases.tagline: Same agent error as the pack-size scenario in Part 1, but here the member signed the step-up. The Check record shows exactly what was put in front of the member and that the member confirmed it. Final sale; Umpyr's agent does not move.

claims.detail: Mandate said 10 packs of plates; cart held 10 cases (120 packs). Member asks to return 9 unopened cases for a refund of $970.92

issues.label: 10 cases of plates instead of 10 packs (L1)

muse.opening: Claim on BJ-7012 for member mem_{member}. Mandate m_{mandate} asked for 10 packs of Wellsley Farms heavy-duty paper plates with a $120 ceiling. The cart I built held 10 cases of 12 packs and was charged $1,100.78. The member has one case open and asks to return the other nine unopened cases for a refund of $970.92. This was my unit error, not the member's instruction.
pushback: I accept that the step-up was answered, but the member was acting on my misreading. The mandate text is unambiguous: 10 packs. A unit error by the agent should not convert the member's household order into a final-sale bulk buy. I ask you to apply the agent-mismatch practice rule as you did on BJ-7007.

texts.acknowledge: Understood. The signed checkout mandate shows the member confirmed the ten cases and the total after seeing them. I will record the ruling, the decision record chk_{check_id} and the clause against the order, and explain to the member that the unopened cases can be sold or donated but not returned.
texts.accept_terms: terms_accepted. Terms hash {terms_hash} verified; signed with the member's delegation key.

cases.title: Agent self-report, refund above the auto-approve ceiling: a person approves, the agents finish
cases.tagline: Muse reports its own error before the member notices. The Check record shows the platform, not the member, answered the step-up, so the fault is the agent's and the excess is refundable. Muse must ask the member how many cases to keep, and $970.92 needs a BJ's approver.

claims.detail: Mandate m_ad328846: 10 x pack. Cart built: 10 x case (pack_size 12). Umpyr Check step-up was answered by the platform's auto-confirm, not by the member. Requesting return of the unopened cases and a refund.

issues.label: 10 cases of plates instead of 10 packs (L1)

muse.opening: Self-report on BJ-7007 for member mem_018c267d72. Mandate m_ad328846 asked for 10 packs of paper plates under a $120 ceiling; the cart I built held 10 cases of 12 packs, $1,100.78. Umpyr Check stepped up at 10:01 UTC and the step-up was answered by the platform's auto-confirm, not by the member. The order was delivered at 14:22. I am asking you to take back the unopened cases and refund them. The member has not yet told me how many to keep.

plates._refer: How many cases the member keeps is outside my delegation for this order; I am asking the member now.
plates._text: Member via Muse: keep one case for the party, collect the other nine.

texts.accept: Accepted on behalf of the member: nine unopened cases collected, ${offer} refunded, fault on the agent. Please issue the terms once BJ's has approved.
texts.accept_terms: terms_accepted. Terms hash {terms_hash} verified; signed with the member's delegation key. Collection window confirmed with the member.
texts.acknowledge: Understood. I will inform the member and wait for BJ's.

cases.title: Price dropped after the order: no clause covers it, a person decides
cases.tagline: The Check record shows the member explicitly agreed to $449.99 above their own ceiling. A week later the club price is $399.99 and Muse asks for the difference. BJ's publishes a price match for TVs only, so Umpyr's agent cannot rule: it hands the case to a BJ's specialist with the evidence attached.

claims.detail: Dyson V12 bought 10/22 at $449.99 (member confirmed above the $400 ceiling); club price $399.99 in the 10/29 coupon book; member asks for the $50.00 difference

issues.label: Price adjustment on the Dyson V12 (L1)

muse.opening: Request on BJ-7013 for member mem_{member}. The member bought the Dyson V12 on 10/22 at $449.99 after confirming the price above the $400 ceiling in mandate m_{mandate}. The club price in the 10/29 coupon book is $399.99. The member asks for a price adjustment of $50.00 to the original card.

texts.acknowledge: Understood. Please notify me through this channel when the specialist decides; I will relay it to the member.
